4f98a2db: What is the magic notebook in the story called?
The Death Note is a notebook belonging to the Shinigami. Anyone whose name is written in it dies under the conditions written.
fd7e23d7: Light Yagami, a brilliant high schooler, finds the Death Note and decides to use it to create a world without crime under the name Kira.
8a10cfb1: Which Shinigami originally had the Death Note?
Ryuk, a bored Shinigami, deliberately dropped his Death Note into the human world to see what would happen.
5dd9b987: What is the alias of the first detective to investigate Kira?
L Lawliet is the world's most brilliant detective, using only the letter “L” as a name to protect his identity.
1ef81d05: What is the first rule of the Death Note?
The name must be written in Japanese
The human whose name is written in this note shall die
The main rule: the human whose name is written in a Death Note shall die. The writer must have the person's face in mind for it to work.
c6014cc6: What is the default cause of death if nothing is specified?
If no cause is specified, the person dies of a heart attack 40 seconds after the name is written.
c6e98a4c: L's real name is L Lawliet, revealed very late. L himself never reveals it publicly.
99fd6cc9: What is the name of L's successor trained at Wammy's House?
Near (Nate River) is L's official successor, more rational than Mello. He is the one who finally corners Kira.
361aa22b: What is the first name of Light's girlfriend, a Kira fan?
Misa Amane is a model and actress, a Kira fanatic. She owns a second Death Note and the Shinigami Eyes.
94579160: What do the “Shinigami Eyes” allow you to do?
The Shinigami Eyes let you see anyone's real name and remaining lifespan, at the cost of half of your own remaining life.
c44828aa: What is the price for getting the Shinigami Eyes?
In exchange for the Shinigami Eyes, the user gives half of their remaining lifespan to the Shinigami who owns the Death Note.
3c874164: What is the name of the former FBI agent who investigates Light?
Naomi Misora, a former FBI agent and Raye Penber's fiancée, secretly investigates Kira and nearly unmasks him.
dd80c915: What is the name of Near's organization against Kira?
The SPK (Special Provision for Kira) is a unit created in the United States to hunt Kira, led by Near.
81775c0e: What is the name of the orphanage that trains L's successors?
Wammy's House is the orphanage founded by Quillsh Wammy to find and train gifted children as L's successors.
1bfd5a98: What is the time limit for writing the details of the death?
After the name, you have 40 seconds to write the cause of death. For the details, you have 6 minutes and 40 seconds more.
3bbf9d1a: What is the name of the newscaster Kira uses as his spokesperson?
Kiyomi Takada is Kira's public spokesperson, Light's former girlfriend, manipulated until her death.
a9518943: Which Shinigami writes L's and Watari's names to protect Misa?
Rem cares for Misa: she writes L's and Watari's names in her Death Note to protect her, which dooms her to disappear.
fe4f8711: What happens when a Shinigami kills someone to extend a human's life?
It returns to the Shinigami realm
A Shinigami who extends a human's life (by killing the person who would have killed them) instantly turns to dust.
dc3078d4: How old is Light Yagami when he finds the Death Note?
Light is 17 when he finds the Death Note. He is a brilliant high schooler and the son of a police officer with the NPA.
c0977bb9: What is the name of Light's sister?
Sayu Yagami is Light's younger sister. She is more ordinary but becomes a stake in later plots.
381c2050: How does Light Yagami end up at the end of the series?
Died of a natural heart attack
Ryuk writes Light's name in his own Death Note, as he had promised at the start. Light dies of a heart attack.
522849be: What becomes of Near at the end of the series?
Near (Nate River) officially unmasks Kira and becomes L's successor, keeping up a similar mystery.
b9b19f94: Which scene between L and Light during their joint investigation is iconic?
The tennis match between L and Light is famous because they test each other, each knowing the other suspects him.
ed74e5a5: What happens if you touch a Death Note without owning it?
Touching a Death Note lets you see the Shinigami attached to it. There is no other effect unless you become its owner.
ee6ef5fe: What is the name of L's elderly assistant?
Watari (Quillsh Wammy) is L's loyal assistant who handles his logistics. He is also the founder of Wammy's House.
f53a8a9b: What is the name of the second Kira who appears after Light?
Misa Amane becomes the Second Kira using a second Death Note that belonged to the Shinigami Jealous.
3ab61b28: Who holds the Death Note within the Yotsuba Group?
Kyosuke Higuchi, a Yotsuba Group executive, uses the Death Note to eliminate his company's rivals.
24e6ff4b: What is the maximum number of Death Notes that can exist in the human world?
Official rule: up to 6 Death Notes can exist in the human world at the same time.
3d8368e8: Teru Mikami is a prosecutor devoted to Kira, chosen by Light to act in his place during the final manhunt.
782f0929: Who is Kira's last servant, a fanatical follower?
Teru Mikami is Kira's last servant, chosen to carry out Light's decisions during the final manhunt.
a0ded40a: How does Light manage to clear Misa when L arrests her?
He temporarily gives up his Death Note
Light and Misa temporarily give up ownership of their Death Notes, losing all memory of their actions as Kira.
b8f61d02: What is Death Note's iconic first opening theme?
“The World” by Nightmare is Death Note's first opening — its staging with apples and the notebook left a mark on a whole generation of fans.
da807fdc: What title does Light want to claim with the Death Note?
The god of the new world
Light sees himself as the “god of the new world” under the name Kira — a deity of justice who eliminates criminals to create a perfect world.
c356f979: Who voices Light Yagami in the original Japanese anime?
Mamoru Miyano voices Light Yagami — a versatile actor also known for Rin Matsuoka (Free!) and many iconic roles.
e68a51ab: In which city does L set up for the Kira investigation?
L sets up in Tokyo for the Kira investigation — he uses a whole building as a secret base and works directly with the Japanese task force.
49d3e8a4: Who created the Death Note manga?
Tsugumi Ohba (story) and Takeshi Obata (art) published Death Note in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2003 to 2006.
659651b7: How does Light get his memories of being Kira back after taking the Death Note again?
The memory returns automatically on touch
As soon as Light touches the Death Note again and regains ownership, all his memories of Kira come back instantly — a trap he planned himself.
ffdbc844: How does Near trap Light and Mikami in the final confrontation?
He replaces Mikami's notebook with a fake copy
He writes in a Death Note himself
Near has Mikami's Death Note replaced with a copy. When Mikami writes the names in it, nobody dies, and Light's name missing from the list identifies him as Kira.
3f4ec244: How does Mello get his Death Note at the start of the final arc?
He kidnaps Sayu Yagami to get a notebook
He buys it on the black market
Mello has Sayu Yagami kidnapped to force the Japanese task force to hand over the Death Note.
db4e351a: Which Death Note character is famous for crouching on his chair?
L always sits crouched on his chair, knees against his chest — he claims this posture boosts his reasoning ability.
c533cc1d: What food is associated with Ryuk throughout the series?
Red apples are Ryuk's passion — he loves human-world apples and will do almost anything to get them.
85f58148: How does Light hide the Death Note in his desk?
In a drawer with an incendiary trap
Light hides his Death Note in a false-bottomed drawer with an automatic incendiary device — if someone opens it without the right procedure, the notebook burns.
8c13ab95: Who is the third candidate to succeed L alongside Near and Mello?
Matt (Mail Jeevas) is the third Wammy's House student — Mello's friend and field partner, he dies on a mission for him.
d1c298f1: What is Near's characteristic habit when he is thinking?
He plays with toys, cards or dice
Near constantly plays with plastic figures, cards or dice while thinking — his childlike side contrasts with his relentless logic.
1af314f6: Which actor plays L in the 2006 Japanese live-action film?
Kenichi Matsuyama plays L in the Japanese films (2006) — Tatsuya Fujiwara plays Light Yagami. A very faithful adaptation of the manga.
d3f6133d: What is the name of Light's father, the police chief in charge of the Kira investigation?
Soichiro Yagami leads the Japanese police investigation into Kira, never suspecting the truth about his son.
56dabc54: Which studio produced the Death Note anime?
Madhouse adapted Death Note into 37 episodes, aired in 2006 and 2007.
3a51d4a9: How many episodes does the Death Note anime have?
The anime has 37 episodes and adapts the whole manga.
300eac8e: In which magazine was the Death Note manga published?
Death Note ran in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2003 to 2006, for 108 chapters.
2fd16201: Why does Ryuk drop his Death Note into the human world?
Ryuk is bored in the Shinigami realm and deliberately drops a notebook to entertain himself.
75301c49: What kind of food does L eat in large quantities?
L eats almost nothing but sweets and claims sugar helps him think. Mello, for his part, munches on chocolate.
d74dd2a0: Mello always has a chocolate bar in his hand.
844cf3dc: Misa Amane is a young model and idol, a fervent admirer of Kira.
91795761: What is the name of the convict L passes off as himself on TV to trap Kira?
Kira kills Lind L. Tailor live, revealing that he can kill without being present and that he is watching the broadcast.
aefdfb13: In which region of Japan does L deduce Kira is located, thanks to his TV trap?
L has the broadcast shown only in the Kantō region. Lind L. Tailor's death proves that Kira is there.
16b87719: Which FBI agent, Naomi Misora's fiancé, is killed by Light?
Raye Penber investigates Light, who manipulates him into revealing the FBI agents' names before killing him.
5ed8c947: At which university are Light and L admitted with top entrance exam scores?
Light and L both get perfect scores on the Tōō University entrance exam and give the freshman speech together.
026f9d57: Near's name is Nate River. Mello's is Mihael Keehl, Matt's is Mail Jeevas and Watari's is Quillsh Wammy.
f05bc733: Mello, raised at Wammy's House, is really called Mihael Keehl.
3640260d: In which language are the rules in Ryuk's Death Note written?
Ryuk wrote the rules in English, the most widespread language among humans, so they would be understood.
b7180355: Which Shinigami comes to reclaim the notebook Ryuk had taken?
Ryuk's Death Note actually belonged to Sidoh, who comes down to the human world to get it back.
d6b2c20c: Which band performs “What's Up, People?!”, Death Note's second opening?
After Nightmare's “The World”, Maximum the Hormone provides the second opening, known for its metal energy.
489494b8: Which director made the American Death Note adaptation released on Netflix in 2017?
Adam Wingard directed this Netflix film, which moves the story to Seattle. Shūsuke Kaneko had directed the 2006 Japanese films.
